newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Zen-Noh says to cut July-Sept feed prices.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Zen-Noh says to cut July-Sept feed prices.

text.p: Japan's Zen-Noh, or the National Federation of Agricultural Cooperative Associations, said on Monday that it will cut the average price of its feed by about 200 yen a tonne for the third quarter of calendar 1997.
The reduction reflects weaker U.S. corn prices and lower U.S. Gulf-Japan freight costs, it said.
Zen-Noh, Japan's largest feed maker, would not give the actual price of its feed. Other Japanese feed makers are expected to follow Zen-Noh's move.
